workspace.description: The workspace whose photo to set, by the slug list_workspaces answered; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

photo.description: The photo as a base64 `data:` URL of a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image (image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp), at most 100000 bytes decoded, such as a 256-pixel square; null removes it, and the member's own first workspace then shows their sign-in picture.
